results.name: test_english_to_german_as_is_check
results.tested: Translating English sentence 'The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.' to German (dest='de')
results.expected: German translation distinct from English source text (e.g. 'Der schnelle braune Fuchs...')
results.returned: 'Der schnelle Braunfuchs springt über den faulen Hund.'
results.details: Test completed successfully.

results.name: test_batch_translation

results.expected: List of 3 Translated objects with dest='ja'
results.returned: List of 3 items: ['おはよう', 'ありがとう', 'さようなら']
results.details: Test completed successfully.
